# Support Policy Document 5 — Northwind

## Purpose
This document defines procedure 5 for the Northwind support desk. It exists to be
ingested by the Aegis pipeline as part of a ten-document concurrency test.

## Rule 5
When a request of category 5 is raised, the agent assigned must acknowledge it within
10 hours. If the acknowledgement window is missed, the request escalates to the
team lead and the SLA clock is paused pending review.

## Escalation
A request escalated under rule 5 requires a written reason on the case note before it
may be reassigned. Reassignment without a recorded reason is refused by the platform.

## Closure
A request under rule 5 may only be set to resolved once the customer has confirmed the
outcome and the audit trail carries the approving agent's identity.
